headline: President Obama changed the text of an earlier executive order, Executive Order 13639.
what_it_does: This order amends Executive Order 13639, which President Obama signed earlier in 2013. The title does not say what was changed. No summary was provided, so the details of the change are not described here.
when_it_takes_effect: Executive orders usually take effect when signed. This one was signed on May 21, 2013.
